Concept.definition: A domain concept, entity, or fallback node for unrecognized entity types.

Conversation.definition: A recorded speech interaction, dialogue, or voice session transcript.

Deadline.definition: A specific date, time, or target milestone by which something must finish.

Decision.definition: An agreed-upon conclusion, policy, or choice that has already been decided.
Decision.example: Adopt Neo4j 5 as the single source of truth for graph memory

Document.definition: A written file, specification, design doc, PRD, or meeting agenda.

Event.definition: A calendar occurrence, party, public demo, release date, or personal milestone event.
Event.example: Birthday Party / Private Beta Release Demo

Goal.definition: A high-level strategic objective or outcome that projects and tasks support.

Idea.definition: A proposed suggestion or possibility put forward for consideration that is not yet decided.
Idea.example: Cache acoustic embeddings in SQLite for instant repeat lookups

Issue.definition: A problem, bug, risk, obstacle, or blocker hindering progress that needs resolution.
Issue.example: Whisper transcription runs out of memory on 8GB machines

Item.definition: A physical product, grocery, purchased good, device, or tangible physical object.
Item.example: Oat milk / MacBook Pro / Sony WH-1000XM5 headphones

Location.definition: A physical room, office, city, or virtual platform where an event or person resides.

Meeting.definition: A scheduled or ad-hoc gathering where people discuss topics and align on work.

Metric.definition: A quantitative benchmark, measurement, or key performance indicator.

Note.definition: A freeform text note, memo, or excerpt.

Organization.definition: A company, institution, partner, or enterprise entity.

Person.definition: An individual participant, employee, or stakeholder mentioned in conversations.

Preference.definition: A stated user preference, constraint, or work habit.

Project.definition: A coordinated workstream or initiative with defined deliverables.

Question.definition: An open, unresolved question or inquiry raised in discussion that requires an answer.
Question.example: Can we offload embedding calculation to the Apple Neural Engine?

Task.definition: An actionable work item that someone must do (distinguished from an Idea or Decision).
Task.example: Benchmark Ollama 8B inference latency on M2 Mac

Team.definition: A formal or informal group of people working together within an organization.

Tool.definition: A software tool, runtime, framework, library, or platform used by teams or projects.

Topic.definition: A subject area, domain, or theme discussed in meetings, notes, or decisions.

ABOUT.definition: Specifies the subject matter topic of a note, decision, idea, or meeting.
ABOUT.example: Architecture Sync Meeting ABOUT Memory Optimization Topic

ABSENT_FROM.definition: Records that an expected person was absent from a meeting or event.

AGREES_WITH.definition: Records agreement by a person with an idea, decision, or colleague.

ALIAS_OF.definition: Links an entity variant or nickname to its canonical entity of the SAME label.

ANSWERS.definition: Links a decision or note that answers an open question.
ANSWERS.example: Adopt Quantized Model Decision ANSWERS Which LLM Model Question

ASSIGNED_TO.definition: Assigns responsibility for completing a task to a person.

ATTENDED.definition: Records that a person was present at a meeting or event.

BLOCKED_BY.definition: Indicates a task or project is actively blocked by an issue or task.
BLOCKED_BY.example: Benchmark Ollama BLOCKED_BY OOM Crash Issue

COLLABORATES_WITH.definition: Indicates direct working partnership between two people.

CREATED_IN.definition: Records the meeting or conversation context in which an item or decision originated.
CREATED_IN.example: Adopt Neo4j Decision CREATED_IN Architecture Sync Meeting

DECIDED.definition: Connects a person to a formal decision they made or championed.

DEPENDS_ON.definition: Indicates a task or project requires another task or project to complete first.

DISAGREES_WITH.definition: Records dissent or objection by a person to an idea, decision, or colleague.

DISCUSSED.definition: Broad link from a meeting to any entity or topic brought up in conversation.
DISCUSSED.example: Architecture Sync Meeting DISCUSSED Ollama Memory Consumption

DISLIKES.definition: Expresses a negative opinion, aversion, or disinterest of a person toward any entity.

DUE_ON.definition: Associates a task, project, or goal with its target deadline.

FAMILY_OF.definition: Indicates familial kinship relationship between two people (e.g. parent, sibling).

FOLLOW_UP_OF.definition: Indicates a task or meeting was created as a direct next step from a prior item.
FOLLOW_UP_OF.example: Memory Tuning Task FOLLOW_UP_OF Architecture Sync Meeting

FRIEND_OF.definition: Indicates interpersonal friendship between two people.

HAS_ISSUE.definition: Links a project or task directly to an identified issue or blocker.
HAS_ISSUE.example: Voice Assistant Project HAS_ISSUE Whisper OOM Crash

HAS_METRIC.definition: Connects an entity to an observed or target quantitative metric.
HAS_METRIC.example: Voice Assistant Project HAS_METRIC Sub-500ms Latency Metric

LEADS.definition: Indicates a person directs, facilitates, or leads a team, project, or meeting.

LIKES.definition: Expresses a positive opinion, affinity, or interest of a person toward any entity.

LIVES_IN.definition: Indicates the home city, neighborhood, or residential location of a person.

LOCATED_AT.definition: Associates a meeting, event, or task with its physical or virtual location.
LOCATED_AT.example: Architecture Sync LOCATED_AT Conference Room A

MEMBER_OF.definition: Indicates a person belongs to a team or organization.
MEMBER_OF.example: Sarah MEMBER_OF Core AI Pipeline Team

MENTIONS.definition: Broad link indicating a note or conversation transcript references an entity.

OWNS.definition: Indicates ownership or possession of an item, document, or tool.

PARTNER_OF.definition: Indicates a romantic, marital, or domestic partnership between two people.

PART_OF.definition: Subsumption link between tasks or projects.
PART_OF.example: Benchmark Ollama PART_OF Local Voice AI Assistant

PLANS.definition: Indicates an intended future commitment, activity, or personal schedule of a person.

PREFERS.definition: Associates a person with their personal preference or favored concept.
PREFERS.example: David PREFERS Fully Local Execution Concept

PROPOSED.definition: Connects a person to an idea or exploratory suggestion they submitted.

RAISED.definition: Connects a person to an issue, blocker, or open question they voiced.
RAISED.example: David RAISED Whisper OOM Crash Issue

REFERENCES.definition: Cites or refers to an external document, specification, or PRD.
REFERENCES.example: Adopt Neo4j Decision REFERENCES RFC-204 Document

RELATED_TO.definition: Generic associative fallback edge between any two entities.
RELATED_TO.example: Benchmark Ollama Task RELATED_TO Whisper OOM Issue

REPORTS_TO.definition: Indicates an organizational reporting relationship between people.

REQUESTED_BY.definition: Identifies the person who asked for or requested a task.

RESOLVES.definition: Indicates that completing a task or executing a decision resolves an issue.
RESOLVES.example: Adopt Quantized Model Decision RESOLVES Whisper OOM Crash

SCHEDULED_ON.definition: Specifies the scheduled date or deadline for a meeting or event.

SUPERSEDES.definition: Indicates a new decision replaces, updates, or invalidates an earlier decision.
SUPERSEDES.example: Adopt Neo4j Decision SUPERSEDES Use Raw SQLite Decision

SUPPORTS.definition: Connects an actionable task or project to the strategic goal it advances.
SUPPORTS.example: Benchmark Ollama SUPPORTS Sub-500ms Latency Goal

USES.definition: Associates a project, task, or team with a software tool or platform.
USES.example: Core AI Pipeline Team USES Neo4j 5

WORKS_AT.definition: Associates an employed person with their workplace or employer organization.

WORKS_ON.definition: Associates a person with a project they contribute to.
WORKS_ON.example: David WORKS_ON Local Voice AI Assistant

label.description: Original relationship type when converted to RELATED_TO.

original_type.description: Original entity type when converted to Concept.

age.description: Age of a person in years.

aliases.description: List of alternate names or nicknames.

birthday.description: Birth date stored as ISO string (do not parse).

op.description: Operation flag indicating lifecycle signal from conversation.

examples.add: Create entity or relationship if missing (default behavior).
examples.update: 'No, I meant Tuesday' -> op: update (correction trigger for conflict resolution).
examples.retract: 'Cancel the meeting' -> op: retract (cancellation / removal trigger).

alias_disambiguation.example: 'Sarah is also called Sarah Perera' -> Person('Sarah') -[:ALIAS_OF]-> Person('Sarah Perera')
